reason: This passage (Exodus 17:8-16) describes the battle between Israel and Amalek at Rephidim. The text recounts military actions, Moses' instructions to Joshua, and the assistance provided by Aaron and Hur, but contains no account of the Hebrew people voicing criticism against their leaders (Moses, Joshua, Aaron) or against Yahweh. The Israelites are not depicted as speaking or complaining; they follow orders and engage in battle without recorded dissent.
